summary: Held the whole window. Entry thesis stayed intact throughout: after a brief -2.75pt dip in the first minute, the trade ran favorably almost immediately (+38 by t=2m) and kept making new highs (peak ~+99.5pts at t=11m), with only normal chop-driven pullbacks (giveback 0-43%) that always stayed net favorable, never threatening to go negative. ER10 dipped near 0 a few times signaling noisy chop rather than a directional reversal, so those dips were not wrong-direction signals. Next time I'd watch for a pullback that actually crosses back toward/through 0 (not just off a local high) or a sustained negative lambda_hat with falling ER10 as the real bail trigger, rather than reacting to giveback percentage alone.
